findings.issue: מִנְחָתוֹ is a common noun (offering) plus a 3ms suffix; minjá leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
The construct סַל is definite through הַמַּצּוֹת; bare canasta leaves that definiteness only on los ázimos.

notes: Ram, qal 3ms acts, singular sacrifice plus plural peace-offerings, Jehová, priest as second actor, and singular suffixed libación match the tokens.
